itemized_evaluation.justification: The paper includes explicit conflict of interest and funding disclosures: 'Competing interests: D.S. is the founder and a beneficiary of FreshCredit Inc... The theoretical results and the patented methods overlap in composition; the author discloses this overlap explicitly.' and 'Funding: None received; independent research.'

The paper is not published in a peer-reviewed journal, and its institutional repository deposit is incomplete/unverified: 'deposited at OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TBD). The Supporting Document and Technical Appendix are in preparation... until they are deposited, the frozen-criteria and protocol claims that cite them are self-attested.'

Prior literature is represented with rigorous caveats and explicit credit: 'GTT therefore states explicitly what it does not originate... The update rule itself is not new — and it is not ours... Kettlewell & Tymula’s own attenuation alternative is carried with the estimate: measurement error could explain much of the stated/behavioral gap...' (§1.2a, §4.1).

Establishes a reproducible protocol with machine-checked formal verification and independent re-implementation: 'The library compiles against the pinned toolchain — Lean 4.12.0 with Mathlib at tag v4.12.0... all dependency revisions pinned in lake-manifest.json' (§2.3b) and 'An independent re-implementation of this specification (seed 20260908; 60 uniform-random initial conditions...) reproduces the qualitative result' (§3.6).

Sampling and initialization in the simulation batteries explicitly control for systematic bias via randomized initial conditions and perturbation grids: '200 random initial conditions on \Delta^4' (Sim G1), 'Sixty uniform-random initial conditions on \Delta^4' (Sim G6), and 'perturbation grid \hat{a}_i \in \{0.5, 1, 2\}\times nominal per channel, 3^5 = 243 settings, plus 50 log-normal draws' (§3.1).

Sample sizes and simulation horizons are explicitly justified via finite-size scaling and autocorrelation times: 'Finite-size scaling (N = 500/2000/5000) confirms the R = 0.7 crossing is a property of the order-parameter curve, not a finite-N artifact' (§3.6) and '64 chains \times 10^5 – 3\cdot 10^5 steps, \geq 30 autocorrelation times per run' (§3.3).

Proper controls are explicitly integrated into the simulation designs: 'Phase-map control battery (200 seeds, K = 0, N = 500... The stereographic map of Definition 4 gives 0.040 \pm 0.021 at K = 0, at the finite-size floor' (§3.4) and 'the constant-truth replication control passes at its certified error... versus the symmetric-adaptive control' (§6).

Appropriate non-parametric and parametric statistical tests are paired with explicit effect sizes and smallest effect size of interest (SESOI): 'median centroid ratio 3.5\times, BCa 95% CI [3.04, 3.69]; Mann – Whitney U = 1600/1600, p = 7.2 \times 10^{-15}; 10,000-replicate label-swap permutation p = 1 \times 10^{-4}... Hedges g = 7.4 [6.2, 8.6] on log-centroids... both groups Gaussian-plausible by Shapiro – Wilk at n = 40' (§3.6), plus 'a pre-registered smallest effect size of interest (SESOI)' (§6).

Randomization seeds, group/condition allocations, and topology parameters are exhaustively detailed: 'seed 20260908... 40 replicas per condition' (§3.6), 'N = 300 users with cadence, sign mixture, tails... seed 42' (§6), and 'Erdős – Rényi (p \in \{0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5\}; \langle k\rangle \approx 25/49/100/249), Barabási – Albert (m = 12 and m = 2; \langle k\rangle \approx 24 and 4)' (§3.4).

Exact p-values, standard deviations, and confidence intervals are consistently reported throughout: 'dispersion ratio 0.053, BCa bootstrap 95% CI [0.0475, 0.0594]' (§3.6), '0.635 \pm 0.014 over 200 seeds' (§3.4), and 'Mann – Whitney U = 1600/1600, p = 7.2 \times 10^{-15}' (§3.6).

Raw numbers, baselines, and absolute metrics are consistently reported alongside relative ratios and percentages: 'with 65 of 300 users (21.7%) outside the corridor' (§6), '243/243 grid, 50/50 draws... mean pairwise Fisher – Rao distance ranges 0.118 – 0.217 across the grid — a 1.83\times spread around the baseline 0.166' (§3.1), and 'mean distance falls from 0.295 to 0.016 (dispersion ratio 0.053)' (§3.6).

Exclusion criteria and full data disclosures are deferred to unsubmitted/unverified external documents rather than logged in the text: 'Power analyses and exclusion criteria are specified in the pre-registration documents' (§6), and in Data Availability: 'deposited at OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TBD). The Supporting Document and Technical Appendix are in preparation... until they are deposited, the frozen-criteria and protocol claims that cite them are self-attested.'

The paper explicitly guards against surrogate marker conflation and separates latent states from proxy readouts: 'Glaeser, Laibson, Scheinkman & Soutter (2000) showed that standard attitudinal survey items... predict the respondent’s own trustworthiness... Any operationalization of S from such survey items inherits this conflation... The empirical program of §6 operationalizes E from elicited expectations and S from behavioral/physiological stabilization markers, never from the survey item' (§1.2b).

The paper explicitly distinguishes statistical/numerical findings from practical or external significance: 'The corridor half-width 0.15 is a pre-registered smallest effect size of interest (SESOI) for an equivalence test — a substantive choice, not instrument resolution... so corroboration inside it is weak evidence' (§6), and 'because the two regimes are defined by validation predictability and the law is linear, spectral separation is close to a consistency check... It is not evidence about the world' (§3.6).

Correlation is strictly separated from causation, and confounding/observer effects are explicitly modeled: 'a cross-country regression in which causality may run from institutions to both trust and growth, and the instruments are weak; we cite the association, not the causation... we note these are associational estimates measured on isolation cohorts and cite them as risk markers, not as links in a causal chain' (§4.4), and 'Open identification note — the \lambda \cdot r_t product confound' (§6).

Figures and visual representations include explicit baselines, floors, and confidence ribbons: 'with the R = 0.7 target, the 1/\sqrt{N} floor, and the K = 4.5 operating point marked' (Figure SR2) and 'Shaded ribbons: 95% bootstrap CIs (10,000 draws)' (Figure SR6).

Hypotheses and parameters are strictly pre-specified, and post-hoc p-hacking or parameter tuning is explicitly forbidden: 'all precision/prior parameters are fixed a priori in the pre-registration (or fit on a training partition), and post-hoc precision adjustment after a failed prediction is forbidden by the protocol' (§4.3, §6).

Simulation durations are explicitly designed to be long enough (10^5 to 3\cdot 10^5 steps) to detect long-term pathologies, relapses, and regime changes: 'Sim G7 (long-horizon simulation, 10^5 events...): (i) under a stationary honest stream with small positive drift, S grows without bound (S = 249 after 10^5 events)... and (ii) a betrayal shock leaves a permanent displacement' (§3.2, §3.6).

Extrapolation limits, saturation bounds, and scope boundaries are explicitly enforced: 'Saturation caveat. Under the physics-layer preset S is an unbounded integrator, so the default index \iota = \tanh(S/s_d) saturates at \pm 1... the index’s useful dynamic range is |S| \lesssim 2s_d' (§2.3), and 'Scope limits and negative domain. (i) Incommensurable domains... \tilde{\varepsilon} is undefined and the law does not apply' (§7).

Results strictly adhere to mathematical boundaries (e.g., probability simplex invariance, bounded distortion, non-negative variance) and explicitly reject implausible physical anomalies: '\tilde{P} is a probability vector (\tilde{P}(o) > 0, \Sigma_o \tilde{P}(o) = 1)... no zero-probability outcome ever becomes attainable' (§2.3), 'Simplex Invariance (Theorem FR-2): \sum_{i=1}^5 \tilde{\theta}_i = 1 identically' (§3.1), and 'explicitly disclaims microscopic non-classical phenomena in macroscopic human cognition or social institutions' (§1.2).
